items.title: OpenAI Scholars
items.summary: We’re providing 6–10 stipends and mentorship to individuals from underrepresented groups to study deep learning full-time for 3 months and open-source a project.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI启动了学者计划，为代表性不足群体的个人提供津贴和指导，支持其进行为期3个月的深度学习全职研究。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于人才培养计划，不涉及模型技术本身。
